lead_independence.headline: Person dies after shooting at Seminole Mobile Home Park in Fort Pierce
lead_independence.lead: A person died after being shot Wednesday night at a residence in the Seminole Mobile Home Park community, according to the St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office. Deputies with the Sheriff's Office Patrol Operations Bureau and personnel from the St. Lucie County Fire District responded to the 3300 block of Orange Avenue at approximately 9:11 p.m. following reports of a shooting. The initial caller reported that an individual had been shot while allegedly attempting to enter a residence.
